title: $S\mapsto\Spec LC(S,\Z)$ is continuous
statement:
The functor $u$ is continuous. That is, for every sheaf $G$ on
$(\Spec\Z)_{\mathrm{proét}}$, the presheaf $S\mapsto G(\Spec LC(S,\Z))$ is a
sheaf on $*_{\mathrm{proét}}$.

proof.text: By [lem-sfb-profinite-to-proetale-finite-limits], $u$ preserves finite limits. The source category $\mathbf{Profinite}$ has finite limits by the inferred Mathlib instance `Profinite.hasLimits` (Mathlib/Topology/Category/Profinite/Basic.lean:217-218). Apply clause (2) of [lem-weil-pbc-presheaf-pullback-sets-left-exact] with $\mathcal C=\mathbf{Profinite}$, $\mathcal D=(\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Z)_{\mathrm{pro\acute et}}$ and $b=u$, placing their object and morphism sets in a common larger universe. For each $Y\in\mathcal D$, its category $\mathcal I_Y$ has objects $(S,\phi:Y\to u(S))$ and morphisms $a:S\to S\prime$ with $u(a)\phi=\phi\prime$. These are exactly the objects and morphisms of $(Y\downarrow u)$. Clause (2) says $\mathcal I_Y^{\mathrm{op}}$ is filtered, hence $(Y\downarrow u)$ is cofiltered. Thus $u$ is representably flat, in the sense spelled out in the leaf used in step 2. Only the comma-category conclusion is used; no presheaf colimit or change of coefficient category is needed.

source.place: Proof, first two sentences: finite-limit preservation implies representable flatness

proof.text: Let $K$ be the pro-étale Grothendieck topology on $(\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Z)_{\mathrm{pro\acute et}}$. Apply [lem-sfb-representably-flat-compatible-preserving] with $G=u$ and this $K$, using the representable flatness obtained in step 1. It gives the compatibility condition for every $K$-sheaf and every presieve, including the set universe needed by the continuity criterion.

source.place: Proof, second sentence: 'and so it preserves compatible families'

proof.text: Put $J=$ the coherent topology on profinite sets. By [lem-sfb-profinite-to-proetale-cover-preserving], $u$ is cover-preserving from $J$ to $K$. Combining this with step 2, [lem-sfb-cover-compatible-continuous] gives continuity. Its conclusion explicitly says that every $K$-sheaf $G$ restricts to the $J$-sheaf $S\mapsto G(u(S))=G(\operatorname{Spec}LC(S,\mathbf Z))$, which is the required assertion.

source.place: Proof, final two sentences: cover preservation and compatibility imply continuity
